message.content:
Assuming the president and vice president elections are independent, the probability that Dan wins president is \(\frac12\), and the probability that Freddie wins vice president is \(\frac12\).

Thus,

\[
P(\text{Dan and Freddie both win})=\frac12 \cdot \frac12=\frac14.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac14}
\]
